title: ModelGatewayDefaults
description: The model gateway's shipped defaults: the clients on this machine, the client models each offers, and the caps and thresholds a delegation is held to. The machine override in $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/agent-kit/model-gateway.json merges over this file and is not validated by it.

binary.description: The command whose presence on PATH means the client is installed.

model_source.description: Where the client's models come from: the client itself, its own configuration, or the declared list below.

families.description: The model families this client serves, where the client itself does not say.

providers.description: The providers a run may reach through the client, by the name its own command line takes: the ones an OpenCode model may name, and the ones a Hermes run may name. A run on any other is refused with provider-not-allowed. Absent means opencode-go alone for OpenCode, and no provider at all for Hermes. OpenCode's own pay-per-token provider, opencode, and OpenRouter are refused whatever this names.

provider_cost_classes.description: The cost class of each provider a client's models run on, by provider name; a provider it does not name takes the client's own cost class.

plan_limits.description: What the client's plan allows, window by window. The shipped defaults carry none: the owner's own plans go in the machine file, which replaces this list whole.

plan_limit.description: One window of a client's plan: the dollars it allows in that window, or the runs it allows, never both. A window reaches back from now, so a $12 per 5 hours plan is watched over the last five hours.

window.description: The span the limit covers, reaching back from now.

limit_usd.description: The dollars the plan allows in this window; spend comes from the ledger.

window.description: The span the limit covers, reaching back from now.

limit_runs.description: The runs the plan allows in this window, for a plan that is not billed in dollars.

names.description: The model names the client's own configuration gives this model, where its listing names it by an alias; the model above is the alias the client accepts.

tier.description: The highest difficulty tier this client model handles well.

notes.description: What the model is good at, in the owner's words.

prices.description: What the model costs, in USD per million tokens, copied from the client's own prices: a run whose client prices nothing is counted at these.

plan_warning_ratio.description: How much of a subsidised client's plan may be used before the gateway warns.

summary_max_chars.description: The longest summary a delegation returns; the full output stays in its file.

availability_window_minutes.description: How long a passively found availability reading counts as current.

output_allowance_tokens.description: The output tokens a run of each difficulty tier is allowed, which is what a metered run's estimate counts at the model's output price. The machine file may override any tier.
